TEAM_DATA.name: Venom — Poison + Airborne
TEAM_DATA.note: Charlotte is the main damage dealer, Johnny adds Poison and Airborne as sub-DPS, and Reina is the Airborne enabler. Poison unlocks Illusion Kick and Poison Grab, and Airborne unlocks Venom Cutter, Shadow Grab, Tempest and Wind Grab, so every conditional skill stays live. This is the game's own recommendation for Charlotte. Alt: Eileen can take Reina's slot as the Airborne starter, adding +15% team Attack (Brave One) and +20% team Crit Rate (Vanguard Banner).

TEAM_DATA.name: Gale — Airborne + Burn
tags: Main DPS + Sub-DPS / buffer + Airborne enabler
TEAM_DATA.note: Kalsion is the main damage dealer, Eileen adds Airborne damage plus team Attack and Crit Rate buffs, and Reina starts Airborne. Three Airborne sources keep Explosion (2173%), Tempest, Wind Grab and Rolling Upper available. Matches the game's recommendations for Reina and Eileen. Alts: Charlotte as the damage dealer instead of Kalsion; Johnny (the game recommends him with Eileen; Poison and more Airborne) or Castella (Break starter) for Reina.

TEAM_DATA.name: Blazeflame — Burn + Airborne
tags: Main DPS + Burn / Airborne sub-DPS + Burn / Stun enabler
TEAM_DATA.note: Kalsion is the main damage dealer. Aria applies Burn and Airborne with almost every attack, keeping both of his conditions live (Burn for Burst Grab, Airborne for Explosion), and Kalien stacks Burn and adds Stun with Finale. This is the game's recommendation for Aria, Kalien and Kalsion. Not S because Aria and Kalien are B-tier damage. Alts: Cerese (the game recommends her with Kalsion; Frost and Airborne) for Aria; Reina as Airborne setup instead of Kalien.

TEAM_DATA.name: Bloodburst — Bleed + Stun
tags: Main DPS + Stun / Bleed sub-DPS + Stun enabler
TEAM_DATA.note: Roxy is the main damage dealer, Theresia applies Stun and Bleed and hits hard on Stunned foes, and Astria adds a third Stun source with Precision Shot. Three Stun sources (Celestial Verdict, Crimson Spiral, Precision Shot) keep Kick Storm (1786%), Divine Arc and Bolt Bombard live. This is exactly the game's recommendation for Roxy and Theresia, and it is close to S with Merciful Death Sentence. Alt: Lute (healer, Stun from Stun Slash) for Astria.

TEAM_DATA.name: Thunderbolt — Shock
tags: Main DPS / healer + Shock sub-DPS + buffer
TEAM_DATA.note: Tarte is the damage slot (Shock, Stun and a conditional heal from Cure), Ornette adds Shock control, Knockdown and +30% Crit Damage for herself, and Sion buffs the team with +15% Attack or Defense (Bless). All three apply Shock and turn it into Knockdown or Stun. Matches the game's recommendations for Ornette, Sion and Ryza. Thunderrush's 3-piece needs Signal skills, so use them often. Alt: Ryza for Tarte or Sion (build her like Tarte), one swap at a time.

TEAM_DATA.name: Frostbite — Frost
tags: Main DPS + Frost sub-DPS + shield / buffer
TEAM_DATA.note: Othello is the main damage dealer on Frozen targets, Cerese starts Frost and adds crowd control, and Dana supports with Chako's shield and a +10% team Defense aura. All three stack Frost and the team matches the game's recommendations, but patch 1.1.0 nerfed all three and their listed damage is the lowest of any full team, so pick it for safety. Alts: Ornette (the game recommends her with Othello; Shock and Knockdown) for Cerese; Alex as a Knockdown tank for Dana.

TEAM_DATA.name: Breaker — Break + Stun
tags: Main DPS / Break starter + Stun sub-DPS + healer
TEAM_DATA.note: Castella is the main damage dealer and Break starter (Stun Blow into Upper Blow), Astria adds Stun and Break damage, and Lute heals and Stuns. Matches the game's recommendation for Castella. Not A because only Castella is A tier. Alts: Theresia (Stun damage) for Astria; Kalien (the game recommends him with Castella and Astria; Stun and Burn) for Lute.

TEAM_DATA.name: Crushing — Knockdown
TEAM_DATA.note: Built around Alex, the only Crushing hero: he tanks with Taunt and his counter cuts the target's Defense by 20%. Othello (Ice Crown, Ice Grab) and Sion (Divine Smash, Justice Fall) both inflict Knockdown, which unlocks Alex's Pounding Grab. This is exactly the game's recommendation for Alex. Othello has no Frost partner here, so his Frozen-only skills fire less often. Alts: Ornette (Shock and Knockdown), Castella (Break starter) or Roxy (Bleed damage) for Othello; Lute (healer, Stun) or Dana (shield) for Sion.

TEAM_DATA.name: Amplitude — Stun
TEAM_DATA.note: Theresia is the main damage dealer (Stun from Celestial Verdict into Divine Arc and Holy Rise), Astria adds Stun and Break damage, and Lute heals and Stuns. Three Stun sources keep Divine Arc and Bolt Bombard live, and Lute's heal makes it the safest Stun team. Matches the game's recommendations for Lute and Theresia. Alt: Roxy (the game recommends her with both Lute and Theresia) for Astria when you want more damage.

KARMA_DATA.name: A Sword Summoned for a Friend
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The number of relics summoned by the Relic Fall skill increases.

KARMA_DATA.name: Merciful Death Sentence
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The damage of the Divine Arc skill is increased. When entering Heretic Judgment mode, movement speed increases, and Theresia's Bleed attacks inflict an additional Bleed status effect.

KARMA_DATA.name: Loyalty Amidst Lethargy
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When casting Guard Stance, Super Armor resistance is increased by 100% for a set time. While in Defensive Stance mode, damage taken by you and allies within range is reduced by 10% (same at minimum and max).

KARMA_DATA.name: Legends Left Behind by the Master
Between Chivalry and Bookmarks
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When using the Banner Maid skill within the area created by the Brave One skill, Critical Rate and Critical Damage are further increased.

KARMA_DATA.name: The Wind That Protects the Kingdom
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The Tempest skill changes to emit a sword aura.

KARMA_DATA.name: Become a Star in That Sky
A Path That Leads to the Wind
The Noble Lady's Wild Hobby
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The number of arrows fired by the Kick Storm skill increases.

KARMA_DATA.name: Explosion Is Art
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When the Switch On! skill is used, a larger explosion occurs, inflicting additional Burn and Airborne status effects on hit enemies.

KARMA_DATA.name: The Chosen One of the Crimson Flame
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The number of foxes summoned by the Fox Grab skill increases.

KARMA_DATA.name: The Sun Blazes Again
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The attack range and damage of the Explosion skill are increased.

KARMA_DATA.name: A Flame That Cuts Through the Moment
The Spear That Fells the Sun
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: Frozen Stinger is enhanced: the range and damage of its final attack are increased. Pressing the attack button again casts the final attack faster.

KARMA_DATA.name: Eternal Blizzard
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When the Ice Storm skill ends, the storm moves toward the nearest enemy. If the targeted enemy is defeated, the storm remains at that location.

KARMA_DATA.name: A Sparkling Tea Time
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When Chako is summoned, frost spikes rise at the summoning point depending on the size of the Ice Clump on Chako's back. The frost spikes deal continuous damage to the target and inflict the Frost status effect.

KARMA_DATA.name: A Helping Hand for Good Kids
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When the Cure skill is used, the magic circle that appears remains active for a certain period and expands in range. It immediately removes physical status effects from allies within the magic circle's range and continuously heals them.

KARMA_DATA.name: The Scar Lightning Left Behind
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: After using the Flash skill, pressing the attack key again unleashes a powerful thrust attack.

KARMA_DATA.name: Sacred Lightning Baptism
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When using the Holy Cross skill within the area created by the Holy Circle skill, the cross becomes larger and the number of attacks increases.

KARMA_DATA.name: Fate Spoke to the Boy
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When retrieving the sacred relic, a set amount of Rage for the Divine Crash and Divine Smash skills is restored.

KARMA_DATA.name: The Conviction Left in Darkness
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The Invisible skill is changed: reusing the skill instantly detonates the summoned Clone.

KARMA_DATA.name: Wandering Blade
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: When using the Phantom Slash skill, blades are generated along the path, dealing additional damage to enemies within the area and inflicting the Poison status effect on hit.

KARMA_DATA.name: So Good It's to Die For
Noisy Duet
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: The Howling skill has been changed to a Hold Action, so holding the skill key increases the skill duration.

KARMA_DATA.name: Wildflowers Bloom Through the Wind
KARMA_DATA.exclusive: In Precision Shooting mode, the Ballista Shot skill changes to a charge action, allowing you to unleash a powerful single shot by holding down the skill key to fire all loaded arrows.

GEAR_STATS.note: From David's in-game gear info (source of truth, still being tested). Main stat values by upgrade level +0..+15; a substat has one fixed value. A piece can't have the same stat as main and substat (flat and % count as different stats). Helmet, Gloves and Boots are currently identical.

HERO_STAT_MODEL.note: Lv.70 base stats (no gear, no Karma). Estimated until measured in-game: replace a hero's numbers in HERO_BASE_STATS and set 'estimated' to false. Every hero levels the same; only breakthrough bonuses differ by hero. Crit comes only from gear, Karma and buffs.

levelCurve.formula: base + b*(L-1) + c*(L-1)^2, fitted exactly to Lv1, Lv20 and Lv30

B.label: Standard (measured on Johnny, Reina, Castella and Lute)

HERO_STAT_MODEL.profileRule: Profile A only for Charlotte (measured); profile B for everyone else. Castella (Main DPS) and Lute (healer) both measured as B, so the profile is not tied to role.

observations.statusResistance: Every status resistance (Stun, Airborne, Knockdown, Shock, Frost, Burn, Poison, Bleed) is 50 on Charlotte with no gear; the same at Lv1.
observations.critRateText: In-game: 'Increases the chance of a Critical Hit ... The final probability is determined by the target's Critical Hit Resistance.' Nothing says what happens above 100%.
observations.setBonusTest: Ballad of Life on Charlotte (no other gear stats, no Karma): Max HP 1975 -> 2152 with 2 pieces (+9%) -> 2271 with 3 pieces (+15% = 2-piece + 3-piece) -> 2271 with 5 pieces. Displayed values are rounded down.
observations.lv1Mismatch: Ornette and Roxy start at 71/30/511 but Aria at 71/20/461 (Attack/Defense/Max HP). The level curve still uses Aria's values. Unresolved: either level-1 stats differ by hero, or the heroes measured at Lv20 started at 30/511. If the latter, the Lv70 estimates rise by about +37 Defense and +181 Max HP for everyone (Attack unchanged).

Johnny.why: Damage dealer in their teams. Main stats and substats are the mix of Attack Power Up, Crit Rate and Crit Damage that gives the highest Attack × crit value (a hit can't crit more than 100% of the time), with Defense Ignore and status Additional Attack Power in the spare substat slots.

Lute.why: Healing Circle restores 20% of max HP and Lute's other support is not stat-based, so her gear can't raise her healing. Chest and legs keep her alive (Max HP Up also raises her own share of the heal); the other three slots add damage.

Castella.why: Damage dealer in their teams. Main stats and substats are the mix of Attack Power Up, Crit Rate and Crit Damage that gives the highest Attack × crit value (a hit can't crit more than 100% of the time), with Defense Ignore and status Additional Attack Power in the spare substat slots.

Aria.why: Damage dealer in their teams. Main stats and substats are the mix of Attack Power Up, Crit Rate and Crit Damage that gives the highest Attack × crit value (a hit can't crit more than 100% of the time), with Defense Ignore and status Additional Attack Power in the spare substat slots.

Dana.why: Chako's shields and the Defense aura don't list any stat scaling, so Dana's gear can't raise them. Chest and legs keep her alive on the front line; the other three slots add damage.

Kalien.why: Status enabler: applying the status doesn't depend on any gear stat, so the gear goes into damage. Main stats and substats are the mix of Attack Power Up, Crit Rate and Crit Damage that gives the highest Attack × crit value (a hit can't crit more than 100% of the time), with Defense Ignore and status Additional Attack Power in the spare substat slots.
